summary.en: Third-party Magpie adapter for dsh-providers-hub (by JetLi): eleven providers, each a separate channel you can sign in to, meter and switch off on its own â AStudio (iFlytek), Accio (Alibaba), LobsterAI (Youdao), MagiCrew (letsmagic.cn / magicrew.ai), AutoClaw (international autoglm.ai / China zhipuai.cn), and Loomy (iFlytek), plus MonkeyCode (monkeycode-ai.com China / monkeycode-ai.net international) and Qiniu MaaS (https://api.qnaigc.com/v1). Channels already in the registry are shipped only with a named difference (#614; see the notes below). Runs without DSH. Its AStudio signs in on a local page (SMS, password or WeChat QR, no desktop app needed) and calls chat/completions; the standalone AStudio plugin (astudio) signs in through a browser or reuses the desktop sign-in, and calls Responses. On one account both share the same daily points pool. Its AutoClaw providers sign in by pasting an accessToken + refreshToken, or by reading an already signed-in AutoClaw desktop client (current Windows user only, off unless clicked) â web OAuth and phone SMS are NOT supported here, use opencode-autoclaw-auth for those. Note: importing rotates the one-time refresh token, which signs the desktop client out; it will ask for sign-in again afterwards. Both plugins read one account's credit balance, so spend in one and the other sees it. Its Loomy adds WeChat QR sign-in (the official iFlytek WeChat OAuth, long-poll for the code) â the standalone Loomy plugin (opencode-loomy-auth) has SMS code + pasted session but no WeChat QR; SMS code sign-in works the same in both (the plugin's local sign-in page offers only WeChat QR and SMS â no pasted-session entry; use opencode-loomy-auth for that), and both read one account's credit balance. Its MonkeyCode providers (new channels, no standalone-package overlap) reach the OhMyAgent gateway over the Anthropic Messages protocol with a per-prompt HMAC signature; sign in through a browser window (the plugin reads the HttpOnly session cookie and exchanges it for gateway credentials) or paste an API key + signing secret; the daily-tier models (monkeycode-basic/pro/ultra/â¦) draw on the subscription quota and unprefixed models draw on credits, with a Cap proof-of-work daily check-in when a web session is present. Its Qiniu MaaS provider (hub-qiniu) is the only Qiniu channel: ported from community PR #374 (lakegan/opencode-qiniu-auth, MIT), which the author closed as superseded by this plugin so registry never gets a second Qiniu entry. It serves 80+ models over the OpenAI-compatible https://api.qnaigc.com/v1 gateway with a static sk- API key; free Conatus and activity models are listed first, and AK/SK usage reading is an optional plugin option rather than a sign-in prompt. The MIT license text ships in the package.
